validation.method: Scan (no text layer): tables read by eye from 200-dpi strips, tesseract only as a draft.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except transmission_final_drive: refs 24, 61, 62 not printed (index agrees). Hood ref 4 printed twice (L.H./R.H. hinge). 7 unnumbered rows kept (engine gasket kit, breaker ignition kit, BR390307 motor, head lamp kit + decal, head lamp assembly) plus 5 unnumbered transmission sub-items (4 under ref 31, 1 under ref 41).
validation.quantities: All rows have a qty; 7 rows are UAR. REQ'D printed out of register on printed pages 23, 23B and 29 (belts x2, brake, PTO, implement lift): mapped in sequence, counts equal, flagged 'inferred qty'. Transmission ref 71 qty is 10 (zoom-checked).
validation.numericalIndex: 569 index entries (part, page, ref) compared row by row against the transcription, both directions: all match after one fix (fuel ref 9 is C18206, first read as 16206). Index oddities: '120- 102' printed for 129-102 (17/8); A27795 and 187-484 out of sort order.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs BR numbers stored bare (390640), Case letter prefixes closed up (C19012, A27795, T25070, M20677, L32763, F53650), hardware codes stored 'NNN-NNNN' (221-13). Printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted.
